prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over ten office visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, stretching, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication. Course of treatment extended somewhat longer than typical for an uncomplicated strain of this type, reflecting a slower rate of symptom improvement. Physical examination demonstrated paraspinal muscle spasm and restricted lumbar range of motion, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient also has a documented history of treatment for the same lumbar region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to the current symptom picture. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered with no duplicated entries. Patient is improving and will continue a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
